'''Cubex Construct''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in the {{2|Overgrowth}} and {{2|Glory}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Cubex Construct}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Charge Up
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = Gains 2 {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Repeater Blast
|Intent = Attack2, Buff
|Effect = Deals (7;{{Asc2|9|8}}) damage. Gains 2 {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Expel Blast
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (5;{{Asc2|9|6}}) damage ×2.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}

After it {{Int|Cubex Construct|Charge Up|Charges Up|2}} it repeats this pattern for the remainder of fight:
* {{Int2|Cubex Construct|Repeater Blast}}
* {{Int2|Cubex Construct|Repeater Blast}}
* {{Int2|Cubex Construct|Expel Blast}}

== Notes ==
* 1 {{BD2|Artifact}}, which negates the first debuff applied to it.
* {{Int2|Cubex Construct|Charge Up}} and each {{Int2|Cubex Construct|Repeater Blast}} each grant 2 {{BD2|Strength}}, so its damage ramps up significantly over time. After the opening {{Int2|Cubex Construct|Charge Up}} and two {{Int2|Cubex Construct|Repeater Blast}} uses, it will have gained 6 {{BD2|Strength}}.
* {{Int2|Cubex Construct|Expel Blast}} hits twice, making it benefit doubly from accumulated {{BD2|Strength}}.
